items.statement: Within the explicitly submitted radical-anion and dianion one-methanol pose subset, the calculation tests whether reduction strengthens methanol binding and whether the derived ΔH_HB is negative.
items.expected: The conclusion is based on the submitted public conformers and exposed fragment arithmetic; the full ConfLEX ensemble is not claimed.
